title: Hearts of Palm Dip
description: This is a rich dip, and easy to make! Serve with water crackers, as you want to taste all the goodies in the dip. A good variation from the same old artichoke dip.
ingredients: 1 (14.25 ounce) can hearts of palm, drained and chopped

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a glass pie plate.
In a medium bowl, mix together the hearts of palm, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, green onion, sour cream and mayonnaise. Spread into the greased pie plate.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes, or until light brown and bubbly. Serve with crackers or Melba rounds.

video.description: Want a change up from the same old artichoke dip for your game day party? In this video, learn how to make hearts of palm dip for the crackers or chips of your choice. First, mix together the hearts of palm with your cheeses, green onion, mayonnaise, and sour cream. Next, put it into a pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Finally, get a hearty scoop of the hearts of palm dip and enjoy! Check out the video to see the recipe in action.
